root.label: Borneo drought, water shortage and peatland fires

events.label: Borneo drought, water shortage and peatland fires

slots.name: people relying on river
slots.sentence: The Kapuas, Indonesia’s longest river that over 3 million people rely on, has extremely receded in the area near her home.

slots.name: peatland drained
slots.sentence: “In Kalimantan, something like 60% of the peatland areas have been drained to make way for palm oil plantations and for pulp and paper concessions,” said Amanda Hurowitz, a senior director at international environmental organization Mighty Earth, using the name for the Indonesia-controlled part of Borneo.

slots.name: smoke drift distance
slots.sentence: The dwindling water supply in the area has slowed down firefighting efforts, while Japan has deployed firefighting assistance to the island.

slots.name: drought duration
slots.sentence: After three months with no rain, Sriwati, a shopkeeper and mother of three children living in Penyeladi village on the tropical island of Borneo, can no longer depend on the river for her needs.

slots.name: fire duration
slots.sentence: In Sungai Malaya village in West Kalimantan, fires have burned for over a month, with residents remaining tense around the clock, as fires have sometimes suddenly worsened at night.
